Scoping doc landed at docs/ai-research/scoping/r7-multi-teacher-warmstart.md (113 lines). Key wins: train_bc.py:361-369 already implements soft-target CE (R12 phase C) so no trainer change; three teachers already wired (rollout/search/planner). Pre-flight pairwise-teacher-agreement probe built into step 1 as cheap go/no-go.

GO. N=300 in 1m 46s. rollout↔search=0.800 (in [0.30,0.85] band), rollout↔planner=0.180, search↔planner=0.230. All-three-agree=0.133 (< 0.50). Mean normalised mixture entropy=0.618. Diversity hypothesis confirmed: planner is structurally different from rollout/search (turn-bundle planning vs greedy leaf), provides genuine per-state disagreement. NO-GO-reweight rule did not fire (rollout↔search stays in band). Planner is ~14× slower per state than rollout (315ms vs 13ms) — projects to +5–6 min trace-gen wall-clock if all three teachers run on every row. Probe at backend/src/sim/r7TeacherAgreementProbe.ts; output at runs/R7-pre-flight-teacher-agreement/probe-300-20260514T061913Z.json. Result block appended to docs/ai-research/scoping/r7-multi-teacher-warmstart.md § 8.

TS schema change landed + back-compat preserved. `DecisionTraceRow.teacher` → `teachers: Array<...>` (length 1-3); `chooseTraceTeacher` calls all requested selectors with per-teacher sub-seeds; `parseTraceTeacher` accepts comma-separated CLI; relabel emits `policyTargets: number[]` with uniform 1/K weights. New smoke `backend/src/tests/multiTeacherTraceSmoke.ts` asserts mixed + single paths. All 6 train smokes PASS (~60s).

Python dataset loader plumbing landed. `PolicySample.policy_target: np.ndarray | None` added; `collate_policy_batch` emits padded `(B, max_actions)` `policy_targets` tensor when every sample in batch is soft (homogeneous-batch policy — mixed batches drop back to hard-CE; the parent corpus mixer is responsible for batch homogeneity, as scoping § 3 commits to skipping mix-sources for v1). Legacy traces without `policyTargets` → `policy_target is None` → trainer's hard-CE branch (`train_bc.py:361-369`) fires unchanged. Smoke at `training/smoke_e2e.py::assert_multi_teacher_dataset_loader` covers: all-soft batch, all-hard batch, mixed batch, one-hot-equals-hard-CE numerical equivalence. Validation: `test:python-train` PASS ~6 min, `test:train` PASS ~2 min.

LAUNCHED. Mirrors R15.S1's iter-0 SL-compute budget exactly (games=90, epochs=75, hidden=64/depth=2, rule-bot replay 100 games → 4432 examples, max-steps=500, rollout-steps=500, rollout-crn=3, eval-games=250) on a single iter so any Δ vs R15.S1 iter-1 isolates the teacher-mix axis. Orchestrator change: added `--trace-teachers` (separate from `--teacher`) so comma-separated value bypasses the existing `choices=[rollout,search,planner]` validator while still feeding TS-side `--trace-teacher rollout,search,planner` (parseTraceTeacherList already accepts comma-separated per R7 step 2). KL-anchor weights irrelevant for iter-0 (no parent checkpoint).

Phase O CLOSED — REGRESSED. iter-2 Wilson 0.3502 (WR 39.2%), 1.8pp worse than Phase N's 0.3677. Trajectory 0.2845 (promoted) → 0.2768 (REJECTED at floor 0.2845, same over-shape pattern as Phase M) → 0.3502 (promoted from iter-0 parent). `promoted_iterations: [0, 2]`. Wall-clock 5m 22s. Mechanism diagnosis: signal correctly wired but magnitude is ~20× the design budget — Tanh output range ±1 gives per-step delta ±2; at coef 0.05 per-step contribution is ±0.1; at ~60 steps/game per-game total is ±6, vs ±0.3 budget. iter-0 shape_attribution.value_head=26.01 confirms empirically; iter-1/2 attributions drop to 9.28/8.25 as policy flattens the delta (over-shape signature). PPO healthy in all non-reward dimensions (ratio_max 12.7/12.3/22.4, entropy stable, no anomalies). Follow-up: Phase P launched at coef 0.01 (5× smaller). Full writeup at docs/ai-performance-research-progress.md § Phase O.

Trajectory clean (no rejections): iter-0 0.2730 (identical to Phase L iter-0 to 4dp; at coef 0.01 the value-head signal contributes effectively nothing at iter-0) → iter-1 0.2845 (no rejection unlike Phase O) → iter-2 0.3463. `promoted_iterations: [0, 1, 2]`, halted=false. Wall-clock 5m 23.2s. Dimensional check on coef ratio passes: iter-0 shape_attribution.value_head = 5.03 (Phase P) vs 26.01 (Phase O), ratio 5.17× matches the 5× coef ratio. **Lowering the coef did not help — the value-head-delta signal mechanism is wrong-shape, not wrong-magnitude.** R15.S3 BRANCH CLOSED across both axes: obs-delta saturated at 0.368 (axis 1, phases L/M/N/O'), value-head regressed at 0.346-0.350 (axis 2, phases O/P).
